integrity: The argument is analytic and uses the published rotation conjugacy, Diophantine nonresonance, preservation of the holomorphic two-form, a Laurent-series rigidity argument, unique ergodicity of nonresonant torus translations, and bounded derivatives under the smooth conjugacy. No finite computation is used as evidence for an infinite assertion.
scientific_limitations: The statement is local to the two biannuli in the constructed projective K3 example. It does not determine the canonical-volume dynamics on their complement and does not settle whether the global canonical-volume metric entropy is positive.
title: Flat canonical volume and ergodic tori in the K3 Herman biannuli
